property_summary: For any call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly later block.timestamp than the stored pastBlockTime, the reference contract always records pastBlockTime equal to block.timestamp afterwards; the mutant that stores block.number instead will violate this whenever block.timestamp != block.number (which holds for many inputs).
change_summary: Assign pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp, changing stored state to block number.
